title: Indexes and unique constraints as atomic guards
description: Indexes and unique constraints as atomic guards.
acceptance: Unique constraints enforce request-nonce uniqueness and one active attestation per (session_handle, epoch, role)
Constraints, not application checks alone, are the backstop for races
findings: Correction: a decision split across a Durable Object and D1 is not atomic. D1 unique constraints and batch transactions are the guard; the Durable Object serializes only revocation list builds, metadata publication and the audit head.
